hints.title: Sorting to Minimize Spread
hints.text: Sorting the scores ensures that any subset of k scores with minimal difference appears as a contiguous subarray.

hints.title: Fixed Size Window
hints.text: For sorted nums, every window of length k from index i to i + k - 1 has difference nums[i + k - 1] - nums[i].

hints.title: Sliding Over All Windows
hints.text: Iterate i from 0 to n - k and maintain the minimum difference across all windows.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: k: size of chosen group of scores
complexity.notes: Sorting followed by fixed-length sliding window sweep.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all (N choose k) score combinations is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting places nearest elements adjacently, turning subset search into linear window scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should sort the array and apply a sliding window of size k.
